title: ContextPackage
description: Scoped information passed to the receiving agent on handoff. Not the full session — only what the sending agent explicitly surfaces.

summary.description: Plain-language description of what was done and why the handoff occurred.

evidence_ids.description: References to evidence snapshots the receiving agent may consult.

current_resource_state.description: Snapshot of the affected resource at handoff time.

outstanding_questions.description: Questions the sending agent could not resolve.
